notes: The dashed remark «قال يحيى بن يحيى أخبرنا عبد العزيز بن محمد المدني» names another transmitter for Yahya b. Yahya's route: a variant group, never a route (rule 4).
The first isnad ends at Yahya al-Ansari; the Anas link is written only after the second route's Darawardi, so it is not added to the first.
Occurrence 3 is the third «يحيى بن سعيد» in the text, the one after the Darawardi.
